svg.title: Same log, same answer: shape beats tuning by 4.9x
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Same log, same answer: shape beats tuning by 4.9x” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. One 1 GB access log feeding two pipelines. The upper five-stage pipeline sorts 8.9 million records before aggregating and takes 135.4 seconds; the lower two-stage pipeline builds a histogram in a single awk pass and takes 27.7 seconds. Beside them, two bars show LC_ALL=C sorting in 20.4 seconds against 86.2 seconds in the default locale, a small branching tree shows catastrophic regex backtracking growing from 37 ms to 31.3 seconds, and a chain of five piped greps is crossed out in red.
svg.text: Same log, same answer: shape beats tuning by 4.9x
draw it from memory, then compare
